Name: Willy and Wizard Heart Events
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
Changes the boat and witch hut unlocking quests to require 8 hearts with Willy and the Wizard (respectively), rather than unlocking the Community Center.

No longer can you ignore these fine NPCs while simply unlocking the Community Center to get their best rewards.

Now, a relationship with Willy and the Wizard is rewarding in itself, like many other NPCs.

+

If you enjoy my mods, consider supporting me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/bennoloth]Ko-Fi[/url]﻿
